statements.sql: select `roles`.*, `model_has_roles`.`model_id` as `pivot_model_id`, `model_has_roles`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id`, `model_has_roles`.`model_type` as `pivot_model_type` from `roles` inner join `model_has_roles` on `roles`.`id` = `model_has_roles`.`role_id` where `model_has_roles`.`model_id` in (2) and `model_has_roles`.`model_type` = 'App\\Models\\User'
select * from `profesors` where `profesors`.`user_id` = 2 and `profesors`.`user_id` is not null limit 1
select * from `estudiantes` where `estudiantes`.`user_id` = 2 and `estudiantes`.`user_id` is not null limit 1

select `profesors`.`id`, `profesors`.`nombres`, `profesors`.`apellidos`, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cursos.nombre ORDER BY cursos.nombre SEPARATOR ", ") as cursos from `profesors` inner join `horario_profesor_curso` on `horario_profesor_curso`.`profesor_id` = `profesors`.`id` inner join `horarios` on `horario_profesor_curso`.`horario_id` = `horarios`.`id` inner join `cursos` on `horario_profesor_curso`.`curso_id` = `cursos`.`id` inner join `estudiante_curso` on `cursos`.`id` = `estudiante_curso`.`curso_id` inner join `estudiantes` on `estudiante_curso`.`estudiante_id` = `estudiantes`.`id` inner join `users` on `estudiantes`.`user_id` = `users`.`id` group by `profesors`.`id`, `profesors`.`nombres`, `profesors`.`apellidos` limit 100

select `permissions`.*, `model_has_permissions`.`model_id` as `pivot_model_id`, `model_has_permissions`.`permission_id` as `pivot_permission_id`, `model_has_permissions`.`model_type` as `pivot_model_type` from `permissions` inner join `model_has_permissions` on `permissions`.`id` = `model_has_permissions`.`permission_id` where `model_has_permissions`.`model_id` in (2) and `model_has_permissions`.`model_type` = 'App\\Models\\User'
